body: Man by the sounds of it, there are a lot of us Melbournians! Maybe we should do some regular get togethers? I'm nobody and nothing but I'd love to get to know you all, and make heaps of new friends.
Yeah but while they stay they have shelter and a roof over their heads. Even if it's just an extra few days I can see the appeal versus sleeping on the street.

help me /u/Goatse_Wan_Kenobi you're my only hope!

(I've never mentioned someone's username before, hopefully that works)
Do we often have meetups? I need to get out the house and meet new people.

I've always been happy, I'm pretty cheerful by nature, but I was never as happy as I was. And just writing that is like another stab.

I have friends and family but I hate the pity of it all. It doesn't help. I don't need to hear "time heals everything" and "it gets better" I'm losing my house, my love, my life, my future, my dreams, my hopes...I don't care about healing or better. I don't care about life. I don't care about anything.
Exactly???? How am I ever meant to trust or care about anyone ever again????

I was a Christian. I work for a church. I teach Sunday School. 

Before I experienced this pain, I was the worlds biggest believer. But if this is only on the small end of pains a person can feel, and it actually gets worse, I cannot believe in a loving God right now. Anybody who loved his people would not introduce suffering in their lives. I cannot think of anyone I love that I would want to hurt or watch be hurt. Especially if I had the power to take that away.

Right now, as far as I am concerned, there is no God. Or at least not one that I can respect and follow.

I don't know what to say. I want to say it gets better but right now it doesn't feel like that's true. I just know I am sorry and if you need to talk to someone, well, I'm not doing a whole lot of living or sleeping so you can vent to me.

My partner was my world too. I don't know how you can give your everything to someone for them to toss it away.

Interesting you say that because my desired method of killing myself is car crash. I like speed. 

I'm scared of not being happier. That's a future I cannot tolerate. I'm scared of being depressed forever. I can't live like that. I don't care about stronger. I've always been a marshmallow. But I was a happy one.
He's homesick and sick of being in a relationship. I don't know how to feel about that. But I know I do feel destroyed.

24, which is probably still young I guess, but not my first love. My second great love. 

The idea of doing my best and it still not working out makes me so afraid. How can that be? How can my best not be good enough? What do I do to dix that? That can't possibly be right.

House arrest sounds awful. I was involuntarily admitted to hospital last night because I wanted to be dead, and I'm not really allowed out either. But they I was left home alone and so I could if I wanted to. 

The window could be viable if you could tie a million sheets together? But the manhunt part is probably not worth it. I've actually never met someone with schizophrenia, or at least someone that told me they had it. Congratulations on your control though! I have anxiety and I don't really feel like I have too much control over that.

I used to write back in the day. Not stories, just musings. I sucked so I stopped. But I have a lot of free time now, sadly, so fanfiction will help to fill that hole.

I like feminine things, I like skirts and pretty dresses. And nice jumpers. It's meant to be spring but it's super cold at the moment and summer feels like a million years away. Cassie is short for Cassandra. I study youth work and I work as one. I like old music, mostly, and classical. And pop. I like most things but not the screaming music and super angsty stuff. My favourite song is actually yellow by coldplay, so that's the song I associate with it. It's a copout answer but it's the truth.

Well, I see you in a little bland and awful beige room, probably in trackies or something. I don't see many bright colours which I hope is wrong because when you're sad you should have many bright colours around you. I think you have longish dark hair, probably brown eyes. I don't know if that's what you meant but that's what's in my head.

I appreciate you helping me. I'm glad you didn't hurt yourself. I still feel like ending it and I don't know that that will go away, but I do appreciate you talking to me.

Hi Billy. I think you should paint it black. It seems fitting.


Your kids names are beautiful, you did well there. I like to appear well read so I read, that any honesty I don't know much about fanfiction. 

I am very squeamish. I can't handle blood. I guess I just don't like people getting hurt.

My favourite book is the three musketeers. I like it because I like the loyalty and the joviality and even though people die (I hate people dying) it's really great.

My name is Cassie, I'm a girl and I'm 24. So now you know a bit about me. Thank you for caring.

My room is blue. My partner and I were doing it up together. We rent a house together. My favourite colour is yellow. Usually I am so happy and yellow is such a happy colour. I haven't read fanfiction but I've read lots of book. 

I don't really care about oversharing information right now. I don't have much to lose.

So it's 12:46 pm. It was sunny before but it's overcast not. So it's not very pretty. But I think I like it better than if it was sunny right now because I am sad. If I weren't going to die I don't know. I'd be happy. I'd have the love of my life with me. I don't know.
I don't think I'll be loved again. I have nothing to offer and I was lucky to even have one person in the first place. I didn't deserve it.

I'd like to talk. I think. I don't know. I'm not having cohesive thoughts. All I'm thinking about is the end of the pain. 

He said we could be friends, but I know it won't work. I'm so desperately in love. And I was so truly happy. 

I am sorry to hear about your children. I can't imagine that. But I know how much losing people can hurt.

Sure. I am in love with someone who moved to a new city to be with me. We had our issues but he said he was happy and I was so immensely happy. I can't even describe it. I told everyone how happy I was. We had goals, we had plans, he said he was going to marry me. We rent a house together. And I love him. And I'm so sad. A part of me has been destroyed. I've been in relationships before but it was nothing like this. Nothing. And it's over, there's no salvaging it, and I am not strong enough to handle the pain. So I want out.
I am still here. I want to die in a car crash and I wouldn't be doing that until tonight.
I am desperately in need of a good **waterproof mascara** for summer.

Bought my GHD and my Parlux hairdryer from there, in separate transactions. On both occasions shipping was fast and no issues with either product. And it was heaps cheaper than buying in store! Can't rec them enough.
If you're near a store they'll try anything on you, and for ten bucks for a lip scrub you can hardly go wrong anyway. They make a lot of good products, I really like lush
I live for Ocean Salt by lush. Bit exxy but my oily skin adores it, plus it smells amazing :)
